feeds.title: Proskauer on Advertising Law
feeds.description: Proskauer is a leading international law firm with more than 800 lawyers in 12 offices around the world, focused on creating value. False Advertising Update is written by the Proskauer False Advertising and Trademark Attorneys and offers updates on advertising & trademark issues.

feeds.description: Sheppard Mullin is a full-service Global 100 firm with more than 1000 attorneys in 16 offices. Since 1927, industry-leading companies have turned to Sheppard Mullin to handle corporate and technology matters, high stakes litigation and complex financial transactions. In the U.S., the firm's clients include more than half of the Fortune 100.

feeds.title: Rebecca Tushnet's 43(B)log
feeds.description: Rebecca Tushnet is an American legal scholar. She serves as the Frank Stanton Professor of First Amendment Law at Harvard Law School. Her scholarship focuses on copyright, trademark, First Amendment, and false advertising. This blog is to save consumers from false advertising, copyright, trademark, and more.

feeds.title: The Trademark Blog » False Advertising
feeds.description: Martin Schwimmer is a partner in Leason Ellis, an IP law boutique in White Plains, NY. His practice is concentrated in the area of U.S. and international trademark law and domain name counseling, prosecution, and litigation. Well-versed in the domain name and other internet-related work, he provides invaluable advice on the full spectrum of trademark work
